sources.title: DRUPEs/CherryPit-1.0-2B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: CherryPit-1.0-2B-GGUF CherryPit-1.0-2B is a ~2B-parameter language model from DRUPEs (Dense Representation & Unified Parameter Encoding Systems), built on MiniCPM5-2B. It's a drop-in upgrade with overall improvements: a comparatively large gain in coding, small gains in math and reasoning, and the same size, architecture and speed as the base model.

sources.title: Dense Representation & Unified Parameter Encoding Systems
sources.snippet: A drupe is a fruit with a hard stone in the middle, like a cherry. That's our idea of a good model: small, sweet, and solid at the center. We make compact models that run on your own machine. 🌱 Our models 🍒 CherryPit-1.0-2B-GGUF
